name: product-wrangler
description: Turn an existing runnable web app into an evidence-backed, complete product without expanding authority.

interface.shortDescription: Turn rough web apps into evidence-backed products.
interface.longDescription: Autonomously infer, bound, repair, and verify an existing runnable web application through ranked product evidence, safe execution, before-and-after journey replay, browser critique, and honest completion gates.
defaultPrompt: Wrangle this existing app into the product it should actually be.
Make this half-baked web app feel complete without expanding authority.
Use evidence and browser verification to finish this existing product.
